why: In today's lead tooling, built the fast-tracked fix for the ticket text 'botpush.mjs and stepcommit.sh refuse plain cloud commits and 0177 fix rounds' (no tracker in the cloud). botpush.mjs now pushes the branch alone when the worktree has no step notes, as decisions 0161 and 0164 make every commit plain; with notes the atomic push, the notes merge and the one retry are unchanged; branch - with no notes refuses before any keychain or network call; a failing keychain read prints one plain line and exits 1. stepcommit.sh gained a fix step for a 0177 fix round that may hold exam paths, takes tests' and build's paths and an exam path the plan gives to no step, signs nothing and still pushes. Every law in botpush.test.ts and stepcommit.test.ts is green, and each plant went red.
note: Found on the way: fast-check ran only numRuns of the pinned examples, so the K4 exam-path law ran 6 of its 9 and the botpush leak law would have run 10 of its 16; both numRuns now cover every example. This cloud box has Node 22, so the pinned Node 26.13.0 came from npm into a scratch folder; box.test.ts needs ssh-keygen, which this box lacked and apt supplied (outside the repo). The start time is the first scratch folder's creation, rounded to the minute. Usage and cost are not recorded. No botpush or step-commit script ran for real here: the box has no keychain, so every push was a plain git push of the branch.
